class _SubprocessSSHResult:
    """Mimics fabric Result enough for our callers (.ok/.stdout/.stderr/.return_code)."""

    def __init__(self, ok: bool, stdout: str, stderr: str, return_code: int) -> None:
        self.ok = ok
        self.stdout = stdout
        self.stderr = stderr
        self.return_code = return_code
        self.exited = return_code  # fabric also exposes ``exited``


class _SubprocessSSHConn:
    """fabric.Connection-shaped wrapper around ``ssh <alias> <cmd>``.

    Uses the SSH alias from ``~/.ssh/config`` so user/port/key all come from
    the local SSH config — same way ``ssh <alias>`` would behave from the
    shell. Workaround for the macOS Sequoia process-internal connect bug.
    """

    def __init__(self, alias: str) -> None:
        self.alias = alias
        self.is_connected = True  # always-on; each .run() forks a new ssh

    def run(self, command: str, hide: bool = True, warn: bool = True,
            timeout: int | None = None, **_: object) -> _SubprocessSSHResult:
        import subprocess as _subprocess
        cmd = ["ssh", "-o", "ConnectTimeout=10", "-o", "BatchMode=yes",
               "-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=no", "-o", "UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null",
               self.alias, command]
        try:
            r = _subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                timeout=(timeout or 30) + 2)
        except _subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            if warn:
                return _SubprocessSSHResult(False, "", f"timeout: {exc}", -1)
            raise
        return _SubprocessSSHResult(
            ok=(r.returncode == 0),
            stdout=r.stdout,
            stderr=r.stderr,
            return_code=r.returncode,
        )

    def close(self) -> None:
        pass


def _verify_connection(conn: Connection) -> bool:
    """Send a lightweight command to verify an SSH connection is alive."""
    try:
        result = conn.run("echo ok", hide=True, warn=True, timeout=5)
        return result.ok and "ok" in result.stdout
    except Exception:
